notes.title: Will Mastery Passives & Bazooka Weapon
notes.content:
[b]Bazooka weapon finaly added[/b]
It's a level 50 weapon available at Mastery Island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/0f55ed36131f6f4ed3d21a9f3303089aca2e4e16.gif[/img]

[b]Added Will Mastery Passives[/b]
Note: balance subject to change, but the goal is to make so high levels are on another category compared to low levels.

[b]Body passives[/b]
1 to 10: The player gains 1 % damage resistance.
11 to 20: The player deals 0.5 % more physical damage.
21 to 30: The player has 1 % chance to half incoming attack damage.

[b]Mind passives[/b]
1 to 10: Increase the player critical chance by 2 %.
11 to 20: The player deals 0.5 % more aim damage.
21 to 30: The player has 1 % chance to reflect 10 % of damage taken back to the attacker. Only the chance to reflect increase every level.

[b]Energy passives[/b]
1 to 10: The player gains 2.5 % more energy for each energy increase.
11 to 20: The player deals 0.5 % more will damage.
21 to 30: The player has 1 % chance to gain 5 % of health for every successful attack. Only the chance to gain health increase every level.

All previous passives increase by 0.2 % each level like below.
Passive 1 will start increase by 0.2 % at level 11 to max level.
Passive 2 will start increase by 0.2 % at level 21 to max level.
Passive 3 will start increase by 0.2 % at level 31 to max level.

[b]Next updates[/b]
Add quests to mastery island that explain everything  including passives while adding new ways to gain mastery experience.
Combat chat log
Bug fixes

[/list]

notes.title: Pirate Souls 1 Year Birthday Bash!
notes.content:
[h3]Ahoy there, fellow sailors![/h3] Can you believe it? It's been a whole year since [url=https://piratesouls.org/forums/topic/11-pirate-souls-on-steam/]Pirate Souls set sail on Steam[/url]. We've been hard at work, and boy, do we have some exciting news to share! Here's a taste of what's been added to the game so far, and trust me, this is just the tip of the iceberg:
[list]
[*] We've spruced up the early levels to make your journey even more thrilling.
[*] Embark on brand new quests that will challenge even the most seasoned pirates.
[*] Discover a treasure trove of new items to enhance your arsenal.
[*] And that's not all! We've introduced the mysterious Smoke Soul Fruit! Master jaw-dropping new techniques that will leave your enemies quaking in their boots.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/13b3dda1789cdcb016904f8cb3f6ac89cee7791b.png[/img]

[h3]But wait, there's more![/h3] We've also developed exciting new features that guarantee long-lasting enjoyment, including:
[list]
[*] An Auto Events system that will keep you on your toes.
[*] A Mob Gears system to help you gear up for battle.
[*] A Referral System that rewards you for bringing your shipmates along for the ride.
[*] Plus, we've made countless small improvements to make your gaming experience smoother than ever! 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/28dd1800bc86c322d37f524681c360b86667f601.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/434239a10c7a03522340a39faea274447f55502b.gif[/img]

[h3]Will of Freedom[/h3]
By the way, [b]the game's official soundtrack, "Will of Freedom," is now available[/b] on popular streaming platforms like Spotify. So, even when you're not battling fierce enemies or exploring uncharted lands, you can still immerse yourself in the captivating melodies of Pirate Souls!

[url=https://open.spotify.com/album/0mkURnxhYIcC0NCtSLYxaX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/0ac90589cbbc609020e7126acb756c91913b27a6.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Exclusive Green Soul Bandana[/h3]
To celebrate this momentous occasion, we're throwing a Birthday Gifts Auto Event for one week! Keep a sharp eye out, as six special gifts will spawn every 15 minutes. If you're lucky enough to find them, you'll receive the exclusive Green Soul Bandana, adorned with the original Pirate Souls logo. But that's not all – these gifts are packed with Event Tickets, Berries, Experience, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/f56f01eff3e517913e981008dc382ad324cbaaf7.png[/img]

[h3]We're cranking up Drop Luck[/h3]
But that's not the only surprise we have in store for you. For the whole week-end, we're cranking up Drop Luck. Prepare to be amazed as every mob drop gets a boost! The rarer the drop, the closer it gets to a staggering 150% bonus. And even the more common drops (20%) will be rocking a cool 125% bonus.

[h3]Stunning new hairstyles[/h3]
To add some extra flair to your pirate style, we've stocked up the Event Shop with two fabulous new items: the trendy Smoke Hairstyle and the sleek Black Soul Bandana. And for those looking to make a splash in the Cash Shop, we've got some stunning new hairstyles in store – the bold Spike Hairstyle, the elegant Curvy Hairstyle, the enchanting Mina Hairstyle, and the sassy Keimi Hairstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/169da8f9c17ee6e687b04640cf336a20eb339f91.png[/img]

And as a special treat, we're giving you a 10% discount on all diamond purchases over $5. So go ahead, splurge a little!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/9f0668d42417b4adfcb57a12e6075154d559ea1e.png[/img]

So, what are you waiting for? Come join our epic birthday party and set sail with us once again in Pirate Souls! Adventure awaits!

notes.title: Introducing the Referral System
notes.content:
[b]REFERRAL SYSTEM[/b]
We've finally added a [url=https://piratesouls.org/forums/topic/220-referral-system]referral system[/url] to the game! Hopefully this new system will bring more players!

[b]GIFTS[/b] (Based on Referee Level)
Level 10
Referee and referrer get 250 berries and 1 Note Sheet.

Level 25
Referee gets 350 berries, 1 Note Sheet, and 1 Uncommon Key.
Referrer gets 100 berries and 2 Note Sheets.

Level 50
Referee gets 400 berries, 3 Note Sheets, and 40 Event Tickets.
Referrer gets 150 berries, 2 Note Sheets, and 10 Event Tickets.

[b]DIAMOND BONUS[/b] (As a Referrer)
You'll get 8% of your referee's diamond purchases
If your referee refers someone, you'll get 4% of that person's diamond purchases.
If the person referred by your referee refers someone, you'll get 2% of that person's diamond purchases. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42113318/434239a10c7a03522340a39faea274447f55502b.gif[/img]

notes.title: Territory War Event
notes.content:
[b]END GAME CONTENT[/b]
Added a territory war event in marine fortress! It will allow the winning faction to choose which island's Faction House they want to control. Each Faction House has different perks. One Faction house will allow you to trade keys for reputation points and upgrade the rarity of your key. And the other one will allow you to "trade" achievements for Soul Power (a force that will allow you to overcome your limit)!

[b]How Does the Territory War Works?[/b]
There are two rocks protecting each faction’s flag in Marine Fortress. Once the first rock is destroyed, everyone is alerted. Once the second rock is destroyed, the attacking faction will have 15 minutes to successfully destroy the enemy flag. If after 15 minutes the enemy flag is still there, the defending faction win and will not lose their previous territory (Faction House).

If the attacking faction manages to destroy the enemy flag before 15 minutes, they will have the option to choose which island they want to control, giving them access to that island Faction House.

A successful defense gives the territory war a 30 minutes cooldown before another attack can begin.
A successful attack gives the territory war a 24 hours cooldown before another attack can begin.
Can't wait to have your input on this!
